title: KL to Singapore Bus from Lalaport: Pick Your Drop-off
metaDescription: Taking the bus from KL to Singapore? Leave from the Lalaport hub in Bukit Bintang and choose from 24 Singapore drop-off points, from Bugis to Woodlands.

contentBlocks.content: For the bus from KL to Singapore, you can now board in the city centre. Many coaches leave from the Lalaport Transportation Hub, an indoor terminal under the LaLaport BBCC mall in Bukit Bintang, linked to Hang Tuah LRT and Monorail station and open 24 hours. The hub can handle up to 200 coach trips a day, and about 150 of them are bound for Singapore (The Straits Times). ttklia.com sells coaches from Lalaport to 24 drop-off points in Singapore, so the real choice is where you get off.
This guide lists every Singapore stop you can book from Lalaport, what to check before you pay, how the border works, and the SG Arrival Card.
Key Takeaways

Where do KL to Singapore buses leave from? Many leave from the Lalaport Transportation Hub in Bukit Bintang. Others use TBS (Terminal Bersepadu Selatan) in Bandar Tasik Selatan. Your ticket names the boarding point.
Where in Singapore can I get off? From Lalaport, ttklia.com sells coaches to 24 stops, including Bugis, HarbourFront, Woodlands, Jurong East and Resorts World Sentosa.

Do I need an SG Arrival Card? Yes, unless you are a Singapore citizen, permanent resident or Long Term Pass holder entering through Woodlands or Tuas. Submit it within 3 days before you arrive. It is free.
Can I store luggage before the bus? Yes. The Lalaport hub has 36 paid lockers near the bays.
Can I book the return on ttklia.com? No. ttklia.com sells Lalaport to Singapore only, so book your way back with an operator or another booking site.
Why board at Lalaport

Before the hub opened, many Singapore coaches picked up at the roadside near Berjaya Times Square. Lalaport moved that indoors. You wait in an air conditioned lounge, watch the departure screens, and walk to your bay without crossing a road (The Straits Times). The hub is licensed by APAD, Malaysia's land transport agency, and around 30 operators use it (LaLaport BBCC).
It also sits on the train line. Take the LRT or Monorail to Hang Tuah station and walk across the covered link into the mall. Our Lalaport Transportation Hub guide shows the way down to the bays.

content.heading: Leaving for Singapore? Board at Lalaport
content.subheading: Coaches from the Lalaport Transportation Hub in Bukit Bintang to Bugis and 23 other Singapore stops. Choose your date, time and drop-off on ttklia.com.

contentBlocks.content: Check these before you pay

• Boarding point. Make sure it says Lalaport, LaLaport BBCC or Lalaport Transportation Hub if you want to board in Bukit Bintang.
  • Drop-off address. The stop name is not enough. Check the street.
  • Departure time. Fridays, weekends and school holidays bring longer queues at the border. Leave room in your plans.
  • Total at checkout. Compare the final price, fees included, not the "from" price.
  • Name on the ticket. It must match your passport.
Save the ticket to your phone. You show it at the gate and may need it again at the border.
On the day at Lalaport

The hub is on LG1, East Atrium, of LaLaport BBCC. Arrive early the first time. Check in, then wait in the lounge until your coach shows on the screens. Need to drop your bags while you eat? There are 36 lockers near the bays, RM20 to RM55 for 24 hours (The Straits Times). ATMs and money changers are on the same floor if you want Singapore dollars before you go.
Crossing the border

The coach stops twice. First at the Malaysian checkpoint, where you leave Malaysia. Then at the Singapore checkpoint, Woodlands or Tuas depending on the route, where you go through immigration and customs. Take your passport, phone, ticket and any medicine off the coach with you each time. Note the coach's number plate and colour before you get off, so you can find it again.
The SG Arrival Card

Every traveller must submit the SG Arrival Card with its electronic health declaration before arriving in Singapore. Singapore citizens, permanent residents and Long Term Pass holders entering through Woodlands or Tuas are exempt (ICA). Submit it within 3 days before arrival, counting the day you arrive, on the ICA website or the MyICA app. It is free, so skip any site that charges you to file it. The SG Arrival Card is not a visa; check the visa rules for your passport too.
Coming back to KL

ttklia.com does not sell Singapore to Lalaport, so book your return with a bus operator or booking site, and look for a coach that names Lalaport as its KL stop. Our Singapore to KL bus guide covers that journey, and the MDAC guide covers Malaysia's arrival card.
Frequently Asked Questions
Where does the KL to Singapore bus leave from?

Many KL to Singapore buses leave from the Lalaport Transportation Hub at LaLaport BBCC in Bukit Bintang, next to Hang Tuah station. Others leave from TBS in Bandar Tasik Selatan. Check the boarding point on your ticket.
How many Singapore stops can I book from Lalaport?
You can book coaches from Lalaport to 24 Singapore stops on ttklia.com, from 2nd Link to Woodlands. Open each stop to see which operators run it on your date.
Do I need an SG Arrival Card on the bus to Singapore?

Yes, unless you are a Singapore citizen, permanent resident or Long Term Pass holder entering through Woodlands or Tuas. Submit the SG Arrival Card free on the ICA website or MyICA app within 3 days before you arrive.
Can I book a bus from Singapore to Lalaport on ttklia.com?
No. ttklia.com sells buses from Lalaport to Singapore but not from Singapore to Lalaport, so book your return to KL with an operator or another booking site.
Can I leave luggage at Lalaport before my bus?
Yes. The Lalaport hub has 36 lockers near the bus bays, from RM20 to RM55 for 24 hours depending on size, and you can open yours as often as you need.
Conclusion

For the bus from KL to Singapore, board at the Lalaport Transportation Hub if you are staying in central KL. Pick the Singapore stop nearest your hotel, check its street address, and file your SG Arrival Card before you leave. Then book your coach from Lalaport to Singapore on ttklia.com.
